question: ¿Cuál es el importe total, en euros, de lo que Outillage Besnard SARL pidió en 2026?
query: SELECT SUM(ol.quantity * p.unit_price) FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN order_lines AS ol ON o.id = ol.order_id INNER JOIN products AS p ON ol.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_date) = '2026' AND c.name = 'Outillage Besnard SARL'
